_description: Indian adult prevalence targets used to shift US-trained (BRFSS) model probabilities to Indian base rates (logit shift). null = no adjustment (no suitable Indian figure configured).
_source: ICMR-INDIAB-17, Anjana RM et al., Lancet Diabetes & Endocrinology, Vol 11, July 2023 (n = 113,043 adults aged 20+). Weighted prevalence: diabetes 11.4%, prediabetes 15.3%, hypertension 35.5%, hypercholesterolaemia 24.0%.
_caveat: ICMR-INDIAB measures conditions biochemically/clinically (including undiagnosed cases); BRFSS targets are self-reported diagnoses. After adjustment, probabilities mean 'likely to have the condition', diagnosed or not.
